description: This file defines an Angular component named 'MultipleChoice' that renders a customizable multiple-choice dropdown. It allows selection from options with labels and values, handles change events, and integrates with a dynamic processing system.

classes.name: MultipleChoice
classes.description: An Angular component class for rendering a multiple-choice dropdown with dynamic options and handling user selection.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles the change event of the select element, updating data through the processor based on user selection.

ctags.name: options
ctags.pattern: /^  readonly options = input.required<{ label: Primitives.StringValue; value: string }[]>();$/

fields.name: readonly options = input.required<{ label: Primitives.StringValue; value: string }[]>();
